scope: Actual library and CLI. Authored controls, including a pair observed in the unchanged public Arabic corpus. No language-parser, UTS #39 conformance or model-safety claim.

findings.message: ZERO WIDTH NON-JOINER (U+200C) is invisible and can hide or split identifiers/words without any visible trace.
findings.suggestion: Remove this character unless it is a documented, intentional zero-width joiner/non-joiner for the surrounding script or emoji sequence.

findings.message: ZERO WIDTH JOINER (U+200D) is invisible and can hide or split identifiers/words without any visible trace.
findings.suggestion: Remove this character unless it is a documented, intentional zero-width joiner/non-joiner for the surrounding script or emoji sequence.

findings.message: "а͂" mixes scripts (Cyrillic, Greek) in one word -- a common homoglyph-attack shape. Skeleton: "ã".
findings.suggestion: Confirm every character is intentional (e.g. a Greek variable name is fine on its own, but Latin+Cyrillic in one identifier rarely is), or rename to a single script.

findings.message: "paypаl" mixes scripts (Latin, Cyrillic) in one word -- a common homoglyph-attack shape. Skeleton: "paypal".
findings.suggestion: Confirm every character is intentional (e.g. a Greek variable name is fine on its own, but Latin+Cyrillic in one identifier rarely is), or rename to a single script.
